stories.title: Mbappé marca duas vezes, Real Madrid sofre, mas supera reação do Rayo Vallecano no Bernabéu

en.title: Mbappé scores twice, Real Madrid struggles but overcomes Rayo Vallecano comeback at Bernabéu
en.summary: Mbappé scored two goals as Real Madrid defeated Rayo Vallecano at the Bernabéu stadium, despite facing a strong reaction from the visiting team.

stories.title: Ex-presidente do BRB tinha cinco fuzis, 16 pistolas e munições, mostra documento da PF

en.title: Former BRB president had five rifles, 16 pistols and ammunition, shows PF document
en.summary: Federal Police seized over 20 firearms from the apartment of Paulo Henrique Costa, former president of Banco Regional de Brasília, during a search in April.

stories.title: Os números milionários de 'Dark Horse' que Flávio Bolsonaro prometeu a Vorcaro: cachê de 'Oppenheimer', bilheteria da Zendaya

en.title: The millions behind 'Dark Horse' that Flávio Bolsonaro promised to Vorcaro: 'Oppenheimer' fee, Zendaya box office
en.summary: A Federal Police investigation into the film Dark Horse reveals details about its budget and financing irregularities involving investor Daniel Vorcaro, with documents recently made public by Supreme Court decision.

stories.title: Fachin dá 24 horas para PF prestar informações sobre celular de Vorcaro

en.title: Fachin gives 24 hours for PF to provide information about Vorcaro's cell phone
en.summary: Supreme Court president Luiz Edson Fachin ordered Federal Police to provide information within 24 hours about ex-banker Daniel Vorcaro's cellphone and its current condition.

stories.title: Datafolha: mais de 80% dizem que crise no STF não alterou voto para presidente

en.title: Datafolha: over 80% say STF crisis did not change presidential vote
en.summary: A Datafolha survey found that 85% of respondents reported not changing their presidential vote after learning about message exchanges between a former banker and Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes. Seven percent remained unchanged but expressed doubt, while 4% each either changed their vote or were unsure.

stories.title: Avaliação positiva de Lula vai de 46% em PE a 25% em SP, mostra Datafolha

en.title: Lula's positive approval ranges from 46% in PE to 25% in SP, Datafolha shows
en.summary: A Datafolha poll released Saturday shows President Lula's approval ratings vary significantly across states, with Pernambuco reporting 46% positive evaluations and São Paulo the lowest at 25% among surveyed states.

stories.title: PF encontrou lista com nomes de deputados e ‘prováveis valores’ em churrasqueira de Ciro

en.title: PF found list with names of deputies and 'probable values' in Ciro's barbecue grill
en.summary: Federal Police discovered a handwritten list at Senator Ciro Nogueira's residence containing deputy names and figures believed to represent monetary values.

stories.title: PF encontra na churrasqueira de Ciro Nogueira lista de deputados e fala em prováveis valores

en.title: PF finds list of deputies and mentions probable values in Ciro Nogueira's barbecue grill
en.summary: Federal Police discovered a handwritten list titled "Chamber" at Senator Ciro Nogueira's barbecue grill containing deputy names like Arthur and Hugo alongside numerical figures interpreted as probable monetary values.

stories.title: Datafolha: Maioria diz que crise no STF não muda o voto

en.title: Datafolha: Majority says STF crisis does not change their vote
en.summary: A major institutional crisis at Brazil's Supreme Federal Court has had little impact on voters' presidential voting intentions, according to polling data.

stories.title: Cachê de Jim Caviezel como Bolsonaro próximo ao de Joaquin Phoenix em 'Coringa': os valores pedidos por Flávio a Vorcaro para fazer 'Dark Horse'

en.title: Jim Caviezel's fee as Bolsonaro close to Joaquin Phoenix's in 'Joker': the amounts Flávio requested from Vorcaro to make 'Dark Horse'
en.summary: A Federal Police investigation into the film 'Dark Horse' is examining financing irregularities and has revealed new budget details about the production, which received funding from Daniel Vorcaro.

stories.title: Brasil enfrenta a Argentina no Sul-Americano de vôlei em busca de vaga em Los Angeles-2028

en.title: Brazil faces Argentina in South American volleyball championship seeking spot in Los Angeles-2028
en.summary: Brazil is competing against Argentina in the South American volleyball championship to secure a qualification for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

stories.title: Brasil vence 4º jogo e encara Argentina por vaga olímpica no domingo

en.title: Brazil wins 4th game and faces Argentina for Olympic spot on Sunday
en.summary: Brazil's women's volleyball team defeated Chile 3-0 and will play Argentina on Sunday to secure their place at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, with both teams remaining undefeated in the competition.

stories.title: Fachin dá 24 horas para PF se manifestar sobre dados de celular de Vorcaro

en.title: Fachin gives Federal Police 24 hours to provide information on Vorcaro's cellphone data
en.summary: STF President Edson Fachin ordered the Federal Police to submit information about data extracted from ex-banker Daniel Vorcaro's cellphone within 24 hours, following requests from three ministers for full access to the device contents.

stories.title: PF diz que suspeitos usaram linguagem cifrada em negociação de apartamento para Jaques Wagner

en.title: Federal Police say suspects used coded language in apartment negotiation for Jaques Wagner
en.summary: According to Federal Police reports, Bank Master operators used coded language when purchasing an apartment for senator Jaques Wagner, referring to the R$ 2.45 million property value through references to measurements.

stories.title: Bloqueio de bens no caso Master atingiu pelo menos 12 empresas e 15 pessoas e total chega a R$ 125,6 milhões

en.title: Asset freeze in Master case reached at least 12 companies and 15 people totaling R$ 125.6 million
en.summary: STF Minister André Mendonça ordered the freezing of assets belonging to at least 15 individuals and 12 companies for a total of R$ 125.6 million in the Bank Master investigation, with senator Jaques Wagner among those targeted.

stories.title: Pedidos de vista em sessão do STF sobre Moraes serão respondidos com antecipação de votos

en.title: Requests for review in STF session on Moraes will be answered with advanced votes
en.summary: STF President Edson Fachin rejected a request to delay the session, meaning ministers may advance their votes on the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes or present a motion for his precautionary removal.

stories.title: PF encontrou coleção de vinhos avaliada em quase R$ 1 milhão na casa de investigado no caso Master

en.title: PF found wine collection valued at nearly R$ 1 million at house of investigator in Master case
en.summary: Federal Police discovered approximately 670 bottles of high-value wines and sparkling wines at businessman Thiago Miranda Silva's house during the 10th phase of Operation Compliance Zero on July 9. The seized collection included around 146 wine bottles of various brands and vintages, approximately 530 champagne bottles, and 10 bottles of Petrus wine.
